_metadata.schema_version_change_note: Bumped from 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 in CP2 remediation: junit_emitting_workflows is now exposed both at the top level (canonical CP2 contract path) and at _metadata.junit_emitting_workflows (legacy seed path, preserved for downstream compatibility). The two fields hold the same value.
_metadata.artifact_kind_note: This is a hand-authored seed artifact produced for the no-network-access analysis sandbox. The runs[], runs_by_workflow[*], artifacts.junit_xml_artifacts[], artifacts.deploy_artifacts[], summary.failing_check_merged_prs[], and ci_deploy_events.events[] arrays are intentionally empty because scripts/06_extract_ci_history.py could not reach the GitHub Actions Runs API. When the script is re-run with GH_TOKEN set and network reachable, it overwrites this file with the populated CI workflow run inventory; the run_id and extraction_timestamp will then reflect that execution. The workflows_in_repo[] and junit_emitting_workflows[] fields are populated from the in-repo source-of-truth scan of .github/workflows/ and are accurate at the documented extraction_timestamp regardless of API availability.
_metadata.junit_emitting_workflows_note: tests.yaml does not include -json output or junit-report upload steps; no JUnit XML artifacts are emitted by any workflow at HEAD. M11 falls back to HEAD-only in-repo scan.
_metadata.junit_emitting_workflows_detection_resul: Zero matches for junit/gotestsum/test2json/test-report across all 13 workflows. One unrelated -json match in sync-release.yaml line 43 ('gh pr view ... --json mergeCommit') which is metadata extraction, not test output.

junit_emitting_workflows_path_note: This top-level field is the canonical CP2-contract path for the junit_emitting_workflows assertion. It mirrors _metadata.junit_emitting_workflows verbatim. Per the CP2 review Data Contract Shape finding, exposing this at the top level allows downstream consumers to read it via 'jq .junit_emitting_workflows' or equivalent without descending into _metadata. The semantic interpretation is unchanged: an empty array signals that no workflow at HEAD emits JUnit XML test result artifacts, which forces M11 (Escaped Defects) into its in-repo HEAD-only fallback per AAP §0.5.3.12.

github_api.unavailable_reason: GH_TOKEN environment variable not set or rate limit exceeded
github_api.endpoints_attempted_note: Per AAP §0.2.1.2 the CI history extraction targets two endpoints: (1) the workflow Runs API for the per-run inventory, and (2) the Run Artifacts API for JUnit XML attachments. Both endpoints are documented here because both would be exercised when github_api.available flips to true. When the live script (scripts/06_extract_ci_history.py) runs, the first endpoint is paginated by 100 with the branch filter set to the default branch; the second is invoked once per run id returned by the first.

ci_deploy_events.note: Used as Metric 9 (Releases) third-tier source per AAP §0.5.3.10 when no git tags and Releases API also unavailable.
